attempted_claim: Fix PII alpha=1 with rational solution w(t)=-1/t. Let VE4 be the fourth variational system written as a block-triangular linear differential system over K=C(t) in jet coordinates along w (Kolchin-Kovacic form, no transcendental scalar forcing). Let G3 be the variational Galois group at order 3, known to have dimension 8. Does the order-4 Galois group G4 satisfy dim G4 = 8 (stabilization) versus dim G4 > 8 (strict growth)? A complete answer computes dim G4 with exact Lie algebra and unipotent-radical data via constructive reduced forms, proving stabilization or strict growth.
claim_type: order-4 variational Galois dimension stabilization vs growth
decisive_failure: VE1-level local Frobenius and bounded Riccati checks were verified computationally, but Kovacic cases 2-3, the explicit VE1 fundamental system, the dimension-8 order-3 reduced basis, and the VE4 gauge-obstruction test all remain out of reach with sympy-only tooling and no literature retrieval; hence no claim about dim G4 stabilization versus growth is made.
